How to Make Your Best Friend Feel Special: Thoughtful Ideas and Messages

Find meaningful ways to appreciate your best friend with shared memories, small gestures, birthday surprises and personal thank-you messages.

Friendship deserves thoughtful attention too. Making your best friend feel special can be as simple as remembering something important, showing up when they need support or creating a small keepsake that celebrates the memories you share.

Friendship & Gratitude8 min readUpdated 7 November 2026
Written by RA FahimWishly Guide Editorial

Show up in everyday ways

Check in before an important event, remember a date they care about or offer practical help when life gets busy. Let them know you are thinking of them without expecting them to reply immediately.

Friendship is built through consistency. A grand birthday surprise can be lovely, but being reliable throughout the year often means more.

Celebrate shared memories

Choose a few photos, inside jokes or moments that represent your friendship. You could revisit a favourite place, recreate an old activity or make a playlist connected to a memorable time.

Make sure the memories are comfortable for both of you to revisit. Avoid sharing embarrassing photographs or private stories publicly unless your friend has agreed.

Write a specific thank-you message

Mention what your friend did, why it mattered and what you appreciate about them. “Thank you for listening when I needed to talk. You made a difficult week feel less heavy” is more personal than a generic compliment.

You can write a longer note for a birthday, friendship anniversary or after a meaningful event. Use your normal voice and avoid exaggerated claims that do not reflect the friendship.

Advertisements

Create a digital friendship surprise

Wishly’s Best Friend Forever, friendship arcade and gratitude templates can help turn a message and shared memories into one personal webpage. Add a few captions, a greeting and one clear closing message.

Preview the page on mobile and check every photo and button. Share it privately if it includes personal memories, and do not publish information your friend would prefer to keep between you.

Respect how your friend likes to celebrate

Some people enjoy surprises and group plans; others prefer a quiet coffee or a private message. Ask about their preferences and make the plan fit their schedule and energy.

A thoughtful friendship gesture does not need a response or a public reaction. Give the person room to enjoy it in their own way.

Frequently asked questions

What is a unique surprise for a best friend?

A memory page with shared photos, captions and a personal thank-you note can be meaningful.

How do I make my best friend feel appreciated?

Be present, remember important details and say specifically what you value about the friendship.
